clientFunction.name: get_category_breakdown
clientFunction.description: Return one month's totals and top 3 vendors for a single spending category. Call this when the customer asks about a specific category — 'how much on coffee?', 'show me my groceries', 'what did I spend on transport last month?'. Returns { category, month_label, total, top_vendors:[{vendor,total,count}] }. Pass show=true when the customer asked to SEE the breakdown ("show me coffee", "break down my groceries"): the app navigates to the spending page and surfaces the category-drilldown view in addition to returning the data.

month.description: Optional. 0 = current month (default), 1 = last month, 2 = two months ago.

show.description: Optional. When true, the app also navigates to the spending page and surfaces the category-drilldown view. Use when the customer asked to SEE; omit (or false) for pure data lookups like 'how much on coffee this month?'.
